instruction: I find VLC's popup notifications distracting when I'm watching videos. Can you disable the on-screen notification popups that appear when playing media?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling VLC's popup notifications. The evaluator checks if the 'qt-notification' setting in VLC configuration is set to 0 (disabled). This is similar to the original task which modifies VLC settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to disable VLC popup notifications
Getter (get_vlc_config) properly extracts VLC configuration file from OS-specific location
Metric (check_vlc_qt_notification__efa02ee6) correctly parses vlcrc file and checks qt-notification setting
Metric correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('expected_notification') without trying to access expected.get('rules')
Expected value '0' is semantically correct for disabling VLC notifications (0=disabled, 1=enabled)
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure configuration is written to disk
Complete coverage: all instruction requirements are verified
Edge cases handled: defaults to '1' if setting not found, handles type conversion, ignores commented lines
